messages:
carla: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit delivery status. Milestone: quant recs + batching/caching for OptKit v0.6. Owners: @alice (quant), @ben (batching/cache), @mike (integration). Can each owner post a one-line status + blockers? Thanks :eyes:

alice: Quant recommendations mostly done. PR: https://git.example.com/r/infer/optkit/pulls/4821 -- added per-layer scale calibration and int8 profiles. Perf: ~1.8x throughput on 13B in local perf test, latency +3% median. Blocker: local eval shows a regression on our abstractive summarization suite (~0.6 ROUGE-L drop). Investigating whether calibration clipping is too aggressive.

ben: Batching/cache work in PR https://git.example.com/r/infer/optkit/pulls/4833. Updated batching.yaml to allow adaptive batching by route, default batch_size 8 for chat and 16 for embeddings. E2E smoke on staging failed due to KV cache eviction TTL bug (memory growth). Eng-sre ticket INF-2275 filed.

ben: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat
    batch_size: 8
    max_latency_ms: 120
  - name: embedding
    batch_size: 16
    max_latency_ms: 500
cache:
  kv_ttl_seconds: 3600
  eviction_policy: lru
```

mike: Integration blocked on model-compiler bump (runtime needs 2.5.0 for new quant kernels). Compiler PR #109 is the blocker. Tentative ETA: EOD Thu if PR merges and CI passes. Also there's a small serving contract change (added `quant_profile` field) — @devex FYI.

ci-bot: [ci] PR 4821 — tests failed: unit (2 failed), integration (1 failed). Logs: https://ci.internal/4821/logs. Auto-retrigger scheduled.

alice: The failing integration test is the summarization eval harness. Pushed diagnostic branch refs/heads/4821-no-clip to run ablation (disabled per-layer clipping) — will post results shortly.

ben: For the KV TTL issue I pushed a staging hotfix branch (4833-hotfix). @sophia can you review mem profile when you have a sec?

sophia: Ack — I'm looking now. Memory spikes ~30s after warmup, eviction appears not firing due to refcount leak in cache wrapper. Uploading heap dump and profile.

sophia: Heap dump: https://internal/heap/4833/hdump1 (password protected internal link). Starting root-cause trace.

carla: Action items:
1) @alice run clipped vs unclipped ablation and post eval numbers by EOD today;
2) @ben coordinate with @sophia to confirm KV fix and merge 4833-hotfix to staging;
3) @mike track compiler PR #109 and confirm green or ETA for roll;
4) I'll gate a coordinated canary for OptKit v0.6 once quant regressions are resolved.
If anyone needs extra heads, drop into #eng-runtime today. Thanks :thumbsup:

alice: Will run ablation and post results in this thread within 3h.
mike: Will update timeline as soon as compiler CI flips green.
sophia: Heap dump uploaded and initial trace points to a dangling reference in cache iterator, will follow up with a short patch.

carla: Cool — let's reconvene async here. If anything gets urgent, call out with :loudspeaker: and I'll pull in PM/ops.
